name: Arab Conquest of Iberia
summary: Tariq ibn Ziyad crosses the Strait of Gibraltar with a Berber-Arab army, defeats Visigothic King Roderic at the Battle of Guadalete, and sweeps through Iberia within three years. Only the mountainous north resists. The Muslim-Berber conquest creates al-Andalus, which becomes one of medieval Europe's most sophisticated civilizations.

_quarry.structural_significance: Removes the Visigothic kingdom and creates al-Andalus; the Christian remnants in Asturias launch the Reconquista that lasts 781 years; the cultural interaction of Islam, Christianity, and Judaism in Iberia produces exceptional intellectual achievements.
